def determine_winner(S):

    white_index = S.index('W')
    
    # Count the number of black cells on the left and right of the white cell
    left_black_count = white_index
    right_black_count = len(S) - white_index - 1
    
    # If the total number of black cells is even, Chef wins
    if (left_black_count + right_black_count) % 2 == 0:

    else:
